**0.8.0: minimise the floating mic with a double-tap.**

- New: when the floating mic is in the way, double-tap it and it shrinks to a small dot in the same place. Tap the dot to bring the mic back. It never disappears, so it is there when you need it. A take started from a Bluetooth remote or a key shows the full mic until it is done.
- A single tap on the idle mic now starts the take after a short pause (about a third of a second), so it can tell a tap from a double-tap. Stop is still instant.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
